bullets: Avoided naive fixed-size character splitting, which often cuts sentences in half and loses regulatory context.
Implemented recursive hierarchical chunking: parsed documents by Chapter (Bab), Article (Pasal), and Verse (Ayat) boundaries.

Configured an adaptive overlap (around 10-15%) to maintain cross-boundary semantic coherence for multi-clause reasoning.
closing: This structured approach ensured that when an ASN searched for a specific regulation, the retrieval returned the complete legal context rather than fragmented text.

opening_hook: In dense retrieval, bi-encoders are fast for initial search but lack token-to-token cross-attention between the query and candidate documents...
bullets: Adopted a two-stage retrieval pipeline: First-stage dense retrieval with ChromaDB retrieves top-K candidate chunks (e.g. K=30).
Second-stage reranking: Fed candidate pairs into BAAI/bge-reranker-base, which computes full joint cross-attention across all tokens.
Cross-Encoder assigned fine-grained relevance scores, filtering out superficial keyword matches and surfacing true semantic matches to top-5.
This two-stage design balanced high speed (under 100ms) with state-of-the-art ranking precision.
closing: It allowed the LLM to receive only the most concise and accurate context, dramatically cutting prompt token cost and hallucination.

opening_hook: The Lost in the Middle phenomenon stems from both the intrinsic architecture of Transformers and how language models are pre-trained...
bullets: Primacy and Recency Effects: LLMs naturally pay higher attention to tokens at the very beginning (prompt instructions) and the very end (immediate generation prompt).
Attention Dispersion: In multi-head self-attention over long contexts (K=50 to 100+ documents), attention weights get diluted across hundreds of irrelevant tokens in the middle.
Rotary Positional Embeddings (RoPE) and causal masks inherently emphasize proximal token relationships rather than deeply nested facts in the median.
My research demonstrated that this degradation is just as severe in Indonesian language contexts, proving it is a fundamental architectural bias.
closing: Understanding this root cause inspired my mitigation strategy: never trust the raw order of retrieved documents; always rerank dynamically before generation.

bullets: Query, Key, Value (Q, K, V): Queries and Keys compute pairwise attention scores (Softmax(QK^T / sqrt(d_k))), which weight the Value vectors.

Positional Encodings (like RoPE or sinusoidal) inject sequence order into the permutation-invariant self-attention operations.
